qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Global distribution scale and high catalog availability across 750,000+ MRO and electronic products provide localized inventory convenience; historically delivered 15-20%+ ROCE, though operating margins have compressed from 12.8% to 8.0% as digital catalog competition intensifies.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Broadline catalog distribution of standardized electronic components and MRO supplies faces severe terminal headwinds from supplier digital disintermediation, specialized online distributors (Digi-Key, Mouser), and horizontal platforms (Amazon Business). Compressed operating margins (falling from 12.8% in FY23 to 8.0% in FY25) reflect structural margin fade and limited long-term pricing defense.
qualitative.evidence: Statutory operating margins compressed from 12.8% in FY23 to 10.6% in FY24 and 8.0% in FY25 (adjusted 9.4%). ROCE fell from 29.7% in FY23 to 15.2% in FY25 amid sluggish industrial volumes and increased pricing transparency. Lack of proprietary products or engineer-embedded IP leaves RS Group vulnerable to digital disintermediation and platform aggregation over a 15-year horizon.
